name: AQ Production Score + P4 starter bar (@ArkansasQuant / cfbquant)
census_status: EXTERNAL-REFERENCE — fully published method (cfbquant.com/methodology), held as a method record; the site's standing series is not ingested
stamp_required: player production within position x season cohorts, CFB as of capture
stamp_gap: method fully specified and held; the site's player-level series is not ingested row-by-row

record.source: @ArkansasQuant deep-scroll catalog (full 12 months, ~258 analytical posts) + cfbquant.com/methodology, read 2026-10-15
record.data_source_credit: cfbquant.com (author's model); data: CollegeFootballData.com public API + school sites + 247Sports Composite; the site states NO PFF grades or scouting data are used anywhere
record.definition: AQ Production Score (0-100): the percentile of a player's production within his position x season cohort, averaged across metrics, where each metric is weighted by its measured predictive power — (AUC - 0.5) — against the P4-starter label (did this player become a Power-4 starter). NO proprietary weighting: the weights are the measured AUCs, published with the method. Recruiting rating is deliberately NOT an input — production is scored on what a player did, not on what he was ranked.

p4_starter_bar.definition: the median component values among actual P4 starters at each position — the bar a prospect's components are read against

record.role: ratings-method reference (substrate), sibling to C-285: C-285 opponent-adjusts the TEAM context a QB number sits in; this record scores the PLAYER against his cohort with predictively-weighted metrics and an explicit no-reputation-input rule. The weighting discipline (weight = measured predictive power, published) is the transferable asset for the NFL lane.
